promptText: Which soft brand or collection brands should an owner consider when affiliation flexibility is a priority for a hotel conversion in the Caribbean and Latin America?

payload.rawResponseText:
**As of September 2, 2026**, an owner prioritizing affiliation flexibility for a Caribbean or Latin American conversion should screen brands in two groups: **lighter-touch affiliations that maximize independence** and **major-chain soft brands that trade some flexibility for stronger loyalty and distribution systems**.

## Best options to screen

| Owner priority / positioning | Brands worth considering | Practical view |
|---|---|---|
| **Maximum independence—luxury** | **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, **Leading Hotels of the World**, **Small Luxury Hotels of the World** | Generally the best starting point when retaining the hotel’s name, operating style and owner identity matters more than obtaining a conventional franchise flag. Preferred has an established Latin America/Caribbean portfolio; LHW and SLH are more selective and best suited to distinctive luxury assets. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Flexible affiliation with a global hotel platform** | **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Crafted or Distinctive**; **BW Premier Collection**; **BW Signature Collection** | Strong candidates for owners wanting independent positioning with distribution, loyalty and operational support. BWH explicitly positions these collections around preserving individuality and offers options across luxury, upper-upscale and upscale segments. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/luxury-hotels/en_US/hotel-development/information.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Conversion economics and limited design prescription** | **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**; **Registry Collection Hotels** | Trademark fits upper-midscale/upscale independent hotels; Registry is better for upper-upscale and luxury resorts, including all-inclusive properties. Wyndham specifically markets both as soft-brand conversion options that preserve distinctive features. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Upscale boutique with cost-conscious conversion** | **Handwritten Collection**; **MGallery Collection** | Handwritten should be high on the list where speed, operational flexibility and relatively light brand intervention are priorities. MGallery fits more design-led, upper-upscale assets, but will generally require a stronger experiential and design proposition. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/handwritten-collection-50-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Major loyalty engine—upscale/upper-upscale** | **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**; **Curio Collection by Hilton** | Tapestry is typically the first Hilton option to test for an upscale conversion; Curio fits upper-upscale, full-service and resort assets. Hilton describes both as flexible, conversion-oriented frameworks, and both have active conversion and development momentum across CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Major loyalty engine—upper-upscale/luxury** | **Tribute Portfolio**; **Autograph Collection**; selectively **The Luxury Collection** | Tribute is normally the more approachable Marriott collection for upscale lifestyle conversions; Autograph fits more distinctive upper-upscale/luxury hotels; Luxury Collection requires a genuinely exceptional luxury product. Marriott’s collection brands are specifically structured for independent hotels, although owners should expect meaningful system, QA and PIP requirements. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Luxury hotel retaining its name and identity** | **Vignette Collection by IHG** | One of the clearest chain-affiliated options where keeping the existing name, look and feel is important. It has entered the region through Mexico and Peru, while IHG continues expanding throughout Mexico, Latin America and the Caribbean. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Distinctive resort or lifestyle asset seeking Hyatt customers** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Appropriate for story-driven upper-upscale and luxury hotels. Hyatt emphasizes independence and flexibility, and the collection is expanding into the Dominican Republic through Cayo Levantado Resort. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Highly flexible, smaller or less standardized asset** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**; **Radisson Individuals** | Ascend is positioned around minimal design and amenity constraints and works well for unique upscale conversions. Radisson Individuals is an alternative for full-service boutique hotels, although regional development and distribution strength should be tested market by market. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Emerging light-touch Hyatt option** | **Unscripted by Hyatt** | Worth monitoring for independent upscale hotels because Hyatt describes it as having flexible standards and a light-touch operating model. However, it is much newer and has less demonstrated CALA conversion history than the established collections above. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |

## My recommended first-round shortlist

For most conversions, I would initially solicit proposals from:

1. **Preferred Hotels & Resorts or WorldHotels** — establish the “maximum independence” alternative.
2. **Wyndham Trademark/Registry or Accor Handwritten/MGallery** — establish the flexible franchise alternative.
3. **Hilton Tapestry/Curio** — test the value of a major loyalty and distribution system.
4. **Marriott Tribute/Autograph** — test the strongest full-system affiliation case, particularly for leisure-oriented resorts and all-inclusive conversions.
5. **IHG Vignette or Hyatt Unbound** — add when the asset is upper-upscale/luxury and has a compelling individual identity.

### By asset type

- **Small luxury Caribbean resort:** Preferred, SLH, LHW, WorldHotels Luxury/Elite, Vignette.
- **Upper-upscale beach or destination resort:** Curio, Autograph, Unbound, MGallery, Registry.
- **Upscale urban or secondary-market boutique:** Tapestry, Tribute, Handwritten, Trademark, Ascend.
- **All-inclusive resort:** Curio, Autograph/Tribute, Registry; confirm that the applicable regional agreement and operating standards support the specific all-inclusive model. Hilton and Marriott both have active collection-brand all-inclusive activity in the region. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-and-fuerte-group-hotels-to-debut-amare-cancun-adults-only-all-inclusive-resort?utm_source=openai))
- **Owner determined to retain the existing name:** Preferred, WorldHotels, Vignette, Trademark and BW collections should receive particular attention.

## Do not judge flexibility by the marketing label alone

Before selecting a finalist, compare the actual term sheets and PIPs on:

- Right to retain the existing hotel name and exterior identity
- Mandatory guestrooms, bathrooms, F&B and public-area work
- Local procurement waivers and approved-supplier requirements
- Franchise versus management availability
- Owner’s right to retain its existing operator
- All-inclusive, residence, condo-hotel or mixed-use compatibility
- Loyalty-program reimbursement and redemption displacement
- System, marketing, reservation and loyalty fees
- Initial term, renewal rights, termination tests and liquidated damages
- Territorial protection and brand-area restrictions
- Hurricane resilience, backup power, water and insurance requirements
- Conversion timing and permission to complete work in phases

**Bottom line:** If flexibility is the overriding objective, begin with **Preferred, WorldHotels/BW collections, Wyndham Trademark/Registry and Accor Handwritten**. If distribution and loyalty contribution justify accepting more standards and capital expenditure, add **Hilton Tapestry/Curio, Marriott Tribute/Autograph, IHG Vignette and Hyatt Unbound** to the competitive process. The final answer will depend less on the soft-brand label than on the negotiated PIP, required brand markers, contract term and exit provisions.
